title: Width of the dual formula
statement: For every DNF formula $\varphi$ on $n$ variables, its De Morgan dual CNF has the same width as $\varphi$.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a DNF formula on $n$ variables
replaced:
Let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ variables, that is, a list of terms, each term a
list of literals, and let its De Morgan dual CNF be obtained by negating every literal
of every term. Then the dual CNF has the same width as $\varphi$, where the width of a
formula is the maximum number of literals appearing in any of its terms (equal to $0$
when the formula is empty).
